channel.title: Engineering Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of engineering blog posts from top tech companies

item.title: AI is rewriting the developer career ladder. Here’s how to stand out.
item.description: Learn three ways to get noticed and grow your career as AI reshapes how developers build software The post AI is rewriting the developer career ladder Here’s how to stand out. appeared first on The GitHub Blog.

item.title: Introducing Web Search API via AI Gateway
item.description: Cloudflare AI Gateway now supports native web search API integration in partnership with Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup Developers can now inject real-time web context into model inference calls via AI Gateway, REST APIs, or Workers bindings.

item.title: 8 major updates to Cloudflare Observability
item.description: Cloudflare is launching eight major updates that bring logs, traces, analytics, alerts, dashboards, querying, and telemetry export into one observability platform, with simpler and more predictable pricing.

item.title: Introducing Cloudflare Traces: follow requests through our entire platform
item.description: Cloudflare Traces shows how a request moves through security rules, transformations, cache, routing, Workers, and your origin, then follows it across services running anywhere in your stack.

item.title: Announcing AWS Well-Architected Agent, an AI-powered intelligence to optimize your cloud environment (preview)
item.description: Introducing the public preview of AWS Well-Architected Agent, an AI-powered service that analyzes your AWS environment to deliver targeted, contextual recommendations for improving your applications' cost, security, performance, and resilience—with ready-to-implement fixes aligned to your business goals.

item.title: ShopGym: Realistic, reproducible sandboxes for shopping agents
item.description: ShopGym creates realistic online stores and generates shopping tasks based on each store’s products and features Developers can then repeatedly test shopping agents under consistent conditions.

item.title: Why I tried to kill token billing (and why we kept it)
item.description: Token billing is useful infrastructure, but usually a bad customer-facing pricing model Your invoice should define the value your product delivers, not break down what it cost you to create it.

item.title: Celebrating Our Newest AWS Heroes – September 2026
